name.ja: <ruby>魔<rt>ま</rt></ruby>の<ruby>龍札<rt>ドラゴン・カード</rt></ruby>－<ruby>土<rt>ど</rt></ruby><ruby>龍<rt>りゅう</rt></ruby>

text.en: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing 3 EARTH monsters in your hand, including this card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dragon Card" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then if a WATER monster is on the field, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Evil Dragon Cards - Earth Dragon" once per turn.
